summary: The agent sets up a standard ML pipeline with LightGBM and XGBoost, utilizing 5-fold cross-validation and engineering several useful features. However, there is a critical data leakage flaw because grouped aggregations and frequency encodings are computed on the concatenated train and test sets prior to splitting. Additionally, the agent uses a naive equal-weights ensemble and relies entirely on tree models to handle missing data without any explicit strategy.
